comparisons.question: Suppose a PO is allocated to a test Job but hasn't been received. Does Ordered mean the shop can start, and what planning details still matter?

before.message: No Jobs match this search within your current access.

after.message: A PO allocation does not establish that incoming material has been received or that a Job is ready. Allocated units become Job-reserved stock when the incoming material is received. Planning completeness is separate from material readiness and Production status. Scheduled jobs missing a Job number, requested delivery, labor estimate or customer need planning information; both planned dates are also required.

arguments.query: Production Ordered materials ready planning completeness

after.coverage: incoming receipt/readiness boundary + planning prerequisites; exact Ordered definition not separately present in retrieved static guide
